what_it_shows: Quicken Simplifi web app Settings > Rules page listing transaction rules with if/then columns (payee contains keywords, account, amount range -> rename payee, update category) and the + Rule button. Frame extracted from Delete a Transaction Rule.gif.

Simplifi Create Rule editor: 'If a transaction matches this' payee condition (Original statement name, Is exactly Walmart) with the THEN-side category cascade dropdown open (Business > Advertising, Car & Truck, etc.). Frame from Create a Transaction Rule.gif.

Simplifi Create Rule two-pane editor showing keyword chips (Contains wal, mart), Account condition with specific-accounts dropdown open, and THEN pane with Rename Payee and Update Category (business vs personal categories). Frame from Creating a Transaction Rule from a Transaction.gif.

Simplifi Update Rule editor (editing an existing rule): if-conditions on left, THEN pane with Rename Payee filled and Update Category card focused; Delete Rule and Continue to review actions in footer. Frame from Edit a Transaction Rule.gif.

Simplifi web Transaction detail modal with the Attachments upload area highlighted (cloud Upload button) below Note field, alongside category, tags, split, and exclude-from options. Frame from AttachReceiptTransaction.gif.

Simplifi Transaction detail modal after attaching a receipt: 'Walmart Receipt.png' chip with remove (x) shown in the Attachments area, arrow annotation pointing to it. Frame from AttachReceiptTransaction.gif.
Simplifi Bills & Income Overview page (dark theme): Next 30 Days summary (Income/Expenses/Net), Reminders list sorted by due date with paid state, and monthly calendar with due-date dots.

Simplifi Bills & Income > Cash Flow tab: projected cash-flow chart with reminder plots on timeline, time-range dropdown open (Next 2 weeks .. 12 months), account selection panel, Reminders list below.
Simplifi recurring reminder series detail modal (Farmers Insurance, Every month): Connect biller banner, 6-month payment history bar chart with average line, Coming Up entry, and History list.
